lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Threads first. Bandwidth is how many you get a turn; most actions cost one, heavy ones two or three. Keep one back and it banks as Slack, up to two, and next turn you act with more than you were given.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Tempo is the party gauge. Two points for every thread any of us spends, forty at the top. It is the only thing in this century that gets easier the harder we work.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Three Tempo buys a Rewind. The last thing an enemy did to us comes undone and they take their turn again, differently. I can do it once a battle; a second anchor, or the right training, buys another.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Two Tempo and one thread buys a Fork. You see precisely what an action would do, down to the number, and then decide whether to do it. It is not a guess. It is the same future, read twice.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: And every time we pull, Entropy rises. Twenty for a Rewind, ten for a Fork, more for anything Chronal. Above seventy an Echo of one of us steps out of a version of the fight we did not have, and only Chronal damage will touch it.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: That is the whole bargain, Auditor. Time will give you the turn back. It just wants to be paid in versions of yourself.
